subject: planner, sctx: open enhanced index join pattern by default (#56172)
summary: Enables the enhanced IndexJoin inner-child “multi pattern” by default via `tidb_enable_inl_join_inner_multi_pattern` (new default ON for fresh bootstraps) while adding a bootstrap upgrade step to keep the variable OFF when upgrading older clusters that lack the persisted global value. Refactors IndexJoin inner-side task construction to use `Attach2Task`, ensuring correct task/plan attachment behavior (notably around UnionScan/Projection/Selection/Agg) under the expanded pattern.
